features.name: Posting Account Setup in GP
features.description: Default posting accounts can be defined in GP to simplify and reduce errors when posting transactions. Once accounts are set up, they will default on transaction entry windows and can be assigned at the class and individual record level.

features.name: Business Posting Groups
features.description: Business posting groups in Business Central focus on categorizing who you are buying and selling to, such as by regions, segments, industries or other business categorization methods.

features.name: Product Posting Groups
features.description: Product posting groups in Business Central focus on categorizing what you are buying and selling, distinguished by product line, use case such as manufacturing, retail, or services.

features.name: Posting Setup
features.description: Posting setup in Business Central combines business posting groups (who) with product posting groups (what) to define GL accounts for transactions including sales, cost of goods sold, and other relevant accounts.

features.name: Customer Posting Groups
features.description: Customer posting groups in Business Central define accounts for customers, including accounts receivable and discount accounts, and allow organization of customers by region or other categorization similar to GP classes.

features.name: Inventory Posting Groups
features.description: Inventory posting groups in Business Central allow definition of accounts based on item classification and location, enabling GL account defaults when creating sales and purchase transactions.

features.name: Posting Preview
features.description: Posting preview functionality allows users to view GL accounts that will be used when posting transactions before actually posting, showing how inventory, cost of goods sold, sales, and accounts receivable accounts are determined.
